details.description: GPT-Audio-1.5 is OpenAI's current generally available speech-to-speech model for the Chat Completions API, accepting and producing both text and audio in a single non-realtime request. It merges earlier speech-to-speech improvements into one model, with more reliable instruction following, additional voices and improved function calling compared to the original GPT Audio. It is the model OpenAI recommends as the replacement for the now-deprecated gpt-audio and gpt-audio-mini, and its knowledge cutoff is September 30, 2024.
advantages: Merges OpenAI's speech-to-speech improvements into a single model with more reliable instruction following (Microsoft Azure AI Foundry model catalog).
Adds two new voice options and produces more natural-sounding audio output than the original GPT Audio model (Microsoft Azure AI Foundry model catalog).
Improved function calling reliability over the original GPT Audio (Microsoft Azure AI Foundry model catalog).
Designated by OpenAI as the recommended replacement for both the deprecated gpt-audio and gpt-audio-mini models (OpenAI API deprecations page).
disadvantages: Only works through the Chat Completions endpoint; not compatible with Live sessions, Realtime, Assistants, Batch or fine-tuning (OpenAI API docs).
Knowledge cutoff of September 30, 2024 (OpenAI API docs).
use_cases: Audio-in, audio-out conversational applications built on Chat Completions
Voice assistants that need reliable instruction following and function calling
Applications that need natural-sounding speech output with a choice of voices

notes: Microsoft's Azure AI Foundry catalog page lists image as a supported input modality for this model, but OpenAI's own docs page and the catalog facts list only text and audio input/output; the catalog's modality is kept. No accuracy-style benchmark for this model was found on any maker, host or third-party page.
